messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Persistent p99 latency breach for SolsticePay (dedicated pool: solsticepay-eu-west-3). p99 > 2.5s over 5m. Paging @samir_oncall and #incidents.

maria.s: I'm oncall. joining the thread — pulling dashboards.

samir_oncall: Ack. What's scope? single tenant or pool-wide?

ajohnson: Metrics look concentrated on one tenant (tenant-967) — high request share + large token sizes.

devon.k: Quick snapshot:
```
p99(5m): 3.2s -> steady
p95(5m): 1.1s
avg GPU util: 92%
queue length (pool): 42
Top contributor: tenant-967 ~78% requests, ~30% tokens
logs: increased decode time per token, no 5xx spike
```

olga_cs: CSM on the line with SolsticePay — they're seeing checkout timeouts for some users. Asked for ETA and mitigation plan. They prefer degraded UX to errors.

samir_oncall: Proposed immediate plan: 1) soft-isolate tenant-967 via concurrency cap + fallback model; 2) scale pool +2 instances; 3) monitor p99 for 10m. If no improvement, consider tenant eviction. Who can execute each step?

devon.k: I can scale now — running: `rctl scale --pool solsticepay-eu-west-3 --add 2` (ETA ~4m).

maria.s: I'll apply a routing rule to cap concurrency for tenant-967 and route excess to lighter model: `routing.add --tenant tenant-967 --max-concurrency 4 --fallback-model redwood-mini-v1`

ajohnson: Note: fallback may change logits/format slightly. Olga, confirm customer OK with possible output variance.

olga_cs: Confirmed with SolsticePay: they accept fallback (prefer availability). Request status updates every 5 minutes.

incident-bot: ACTION: suggested soft-eviction (rate-limit) for tenant-967 available. No hard-eviction recommended yet.

samir_oncall: Agreed. Avoid hard eviction unless mitigations fail. Maria, proceed and we watch.

maria.s: Routing rule deployed (id: r-9f3). Monitoring started.

devon.k: Scale command completed — +2 gpus joined pool (instances: 26).

ajohnson: Post-mitigations snapshot (2m after): p99(2m): 1.4s, queue: 8, gpu util: 63%. Looks promising.

olga_cs: Update sent to SolsticePay: "We've applied protective throttling and a fallback model; performance should stabilize. We'll update in 10m." Customer acknowledged.

samir_oncall: Good. Assign follow-up: eng-sre for postmortem, CSM for customer timeline. Tagging #postmortem-required. Handoff to next on-call at ts 1742510500.

maria.s: I'll own the writeup and timeline. Leaving monitoring open for 1 hour.

samir_oncall: Handover complete. Marking this incident as mitigated; keeping thread open for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
